name: GetSpotPriceHistory

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the spot instance. Supports ECS and Lingjun instance types
parameters.help_zh: 抢占式实例的实例规格。支持ECS规格和灵骏规格
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The retention period for the spot instance, in hours. Note that only ECS instance types support this parameter. Default value: 0. Valid values:

1: Alibaba Cloud guarantees that the instance runs for at least one hour after creation. After one hour, the system compares your bid price with the current market price and checks resource inventory to decide whether to retain or revoke the instance.

0: Alibaba Cloud does not guarantee one-hour runtime. The system compares your bid price with the current market price and checks resource inventory to decide whether to retain or revoke the instance
parameters.help_zh:
抢占式实例的保留时长，单位为小时。 注意目前仅ECS规格支持设置抢占式实例保留时长，默认值：0。取值范围：
1：创建后阿里云会保证实例运行1小时不会被自动释放；超过1小时后，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收。
0：创建后，阿里云不保证实例运行1小时，系统会自动比较出价与市场价格、检查资源库存，来决定实例的持有和回收
parameters.name: spot_duration

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying historical spot instance prices. This time must be no more than seven days before the end time. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format using UTC+0, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Default value: empty. An empty value means three days before the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询抢占式实例历史价格的起始时间，最大值不得超过指定的结束时间7天。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。默认值：空，空代表结束时间前3天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying historical spot instance prices. Specify the time in ISO 8601 format using UTC+0, as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. Default value: empty. An empty value means the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询抢占式实例历史价格的结束时间。按照ISO 8601标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。默认值：空，空表示当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page. Default value: *1*. This parameter applies only when you query historical prices for Lingjun instance types
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：当前页码，默认值*1*。仅查询灵骏规格的历史价格时该参数生效
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. This parameter applies only when you query historical prices for Lingjun instance types
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。默认值：10。仅查询灵骏规格的历史价格时该参数生效
parameters.name: page_size
